title: Frame Allowances, Materials Copay and Materials Discount — Vision Plans Provider Schedule
content:
Under the Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement, participating locations price eyewear for Vision Plans members with the figures below. The frame allowance depends on whether the location is an independent practice or a retail-chain location.

| | Exam Plus | Essential 100 | Select 130 | Select 150 | Choice 175 | Premier 200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Materials copay per purchase in network (USD) | 0.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 0.00 |
| Frame allowance, independent practice (USD) | 0.00 | 100.00 | 130.00 | 150.00 | 175.00 | 200.00 |
| Frame allowance, retail-chain location (USD) | 0.00 | 55.00 | 70.00 | 80.00 | 95.00 | 110.00 |
| Discount on the amount above the frame allowance, independent practice only | 20% | 20% | 20% | 20% | 20% | 20% |
| Materials discount off retail | 30% | 20% | 20% | 20% | 30% | 40% |

**Schedule notes**

1. The materials copay is one copay per materials purchase in network: lenses and frame bought together, or contact lenses. A figure of 0.00 means no materials copay.
2. The frame allowance is paid at a participating independent practice or at a participating retail-chain location at the figure shown for that kind of location.
3. The overage discount is an integer percent taken off the amount above the frame allowance at a participating independent practice; it is not given at retail-chain locations.
4. The materials discount is an integer percent off retail for eyewear bought in network without a materials benefit — where the plan has no such benefit, the benefit has already been used, or for additional pairs.

**Illustration (hypothetical charge).** At a participating independent practice on a plan whose frame allowance is 150.00, a frame retailing at 212.40 is 62.40 above the allowance; the 20% overage discount on that part is 12.48. At a retail-chain location the same 20% figure in the table is never applied, because the overage discount is given only at independent practices.
